shortDefinition.en: The subject-distance range that appears acceptably sharp under specified viewing conditions.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 在指定观看条件下，看起来足够清晰的主体距离范围。

en: Depth of field is not identical to background blur or a guarantee of correct focus.
zh-cn: 景深不等于背景虚化，也不保证对焦准确。

example.en: A close portrait at a wide aperture can have a narrower acceptable-focus range than a distant scene.
example.zh-cn: 近距离人像使用大光圈时，可接受清晰范围可能比远景更窄。

sources.title: Depth of Field — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: Acceptable sharpness and the role of viewing conditions.
